title: Implement network split recovery for MQTT
description:
Add support for MoaT-Link/Link gatewaying. The purpose is to recover and
re-sync after a network split.

To do that we need

* a "moat link -s NAME" option which saves NAME in opt.link_name
* an "only:str" argument to moat.link.client.Link that connects only to
  this named server (monitor its announcement in
  run.service.main.server.NAME, instead of run.service.main.conn)
  * after connecting to this named server: ask it which back-end it is
	using (add an "i.backend" command). If it's not the same backend that
	this connection is currently using, drop the current backend and
	reconnect using the reported one. It's OK if that involves tearing down
	the connection entirely. The Link class might require a "backend"
	option that overrides the one from "cfg", if present.

* add test cases and commit here

* a gateway subclass, moat.link.gate.DelayedGate, that delays update messages
  by some time (default 100ms), skipping the update if a message with the
  same metadata arrives from the other end. Use a
  moat.lib.prio.Timermap with a custom object that equal-hashes to its
  path, see moat/link/flow/_main.py:_Copied for an example.

* add tests (a mock gate but do use a "real" link via Scaffold) and commit here

* a subclass of DelayedGate, in moat.link.gate.link.Gate, that connects a
  moat.link.client.Link to a different named server, named by the gateway
  config.

* if we're gatewaying everything, the "run" subpath needs to be skipped.

* Add test cases.

  We cannot simulate a network split, but what we *can*
  do is set up a network stack, create some data, and save them. Then set up a
  second parallal stack that loads the saved file. Next we change some
  data, start the sync-ing gateway, change some more data (on both sides!)
  and observe that all updates get propagated.

* Commit.
close_reason: All 5 steps implemented and tested: CLI option (7dc8471), Link only param (8d118c6), DelayedGate (25b94a9), Link gate (216c8e3), integration tests (95c7400)
